fields.label: KOT Mode
fields.options:
Station Routing
Single Printer
No Kitchen Tickets
fields.description: Station Routing sends each item to its own printer via the routing rules. Single Printer sends everything to one printer, grouped under section headings so the line can still tear the ticket apart — the usual setup for a small kitchen with one machine. No Kitchen Tickets suppresses KOT printing entirely.

fields.label: Single KOT Printer
fields.description: Bridge target (printer name as the hardware bridge reports it). Leave blank to use the station marked Default.

fields.label: Group Under Section Headings
fields.description: Print HOT KITCHEN / GRILL / BAR headings above each block on the shared ticket. Turn off for a plain list.

fields.label: Copies
fields.description: Number of identical tickets per station. Two is common where one copy goes to the pass.

fields.label: Default Loyalty Program
fields.description: If set, walk-in customers default to this program.

fields.label: Enforce Opening Time
fields.description: On: shifts cannot be opened before Opening Time.

fields.label: Enforce Closing Time
fields.description: On: at Closing Time the register blocks NEW sales (the sale in progress may finish); after the grace period any open shift is auto-closed with its last declared count, flagged for recount.

fields.label: Display Key
fields.description: Opens the lobby screen without a login: /order_status?outlet=<name>&key=<this>. Generated on first use. Clear the field and save to rotate it — any screen still using the old key stops updating.

fields.label: Announce Ready Orders
fields.description: Chime plus a spoken call in English and Arabic when an order reaches Ready.

fields.label: Repeat Each Call
fields.description: How many times a number is called. Two is the usual choice in a noisy room.

fields.label: Feedback URL
fields.description: Rendered as a QR code on the screen. Leave blank to hide the panel.

fields.label: Keep Ready Orders On Screen (sec)
fields.description: How long a collected-but-not-served order stays visible before it drops off.
